eli5.text: A new testimonial PDF from The Flex has been added to the public-facing testimonials folder on the website. If you visit the testimonials section of the site, you will now see this document available alongside others as part of the marketing content. You don't need to do anything to access it, as it is automatically displayed to anyone viewing that page.
